title: Authoring, Inspection, Search & Provenance UX
objective: Resolve bounded KFR authoring, inspection, search and provenance UX over completed KFR vocabulary, graph, records, transfer, qualification and owner-evidence integration without weakening visibility, provenance, owner authority or canonical mutation boundaries.

red.failure: Invariant and workspace-install steps passed on the governed self-hosted lanes. Raw Linux typecheck evidence then failed only on TS2307 for the intentionally missing KFR-07 UX contract and KfrAuthoringInspectionSearchPanel.

resolved_contract.projection_model: Visibility-safe read-only UX projection over explicit already-visible KFR-01 through KFR-06 data and source-owner evidence; filtering occurs before counts, search, inspection, provenance display, receipts and AI context.
resolved_contract.search_rule: Search, count, preview/inspection and AI-context derived outputs require the corresponding explicit visibility-projection authorization. Denied derived outputs expose no derived content or hidden cardinality.
resolved_contract.inspection_rule: Inspection is read-only and displays only visible entry detail, owner references and explicit provenance references.
resolved_contract.provenance_rule: Provenance UX displays only explicit existing provenance references attached to visible inputs; missing provenance remains absent/unknown and is never fabricated.
resolved_contract.authoring_rule: KFR-07 composes draft/proposal authoring intent only from an explicit matching allowed AuthoringAuthority dimension; dimensions never inherit. KFR-07 performs no AuthoringDraftPort or AuthoringProposalReviewPort mutation, publication, reveal or canonical promotion.
resolved_contract.canonical_write_rule: Canonical KFR and source-domain writes remain with existing owner ports; KFR-07 grants no canonical write authority.
resolved_contract.source_distinction: KFR-01 through KFR-06 remain separately labeled sources rather than a new truth owner.
resolved_contract.ordering_rule: Visible search results, inspection collections, provenance references and deterministic receipts use stable deterministic ordering independent of input order.
resolved_contract.visibility_rule: Unauthorized KFR and owner-domain inputs are filtered before topology/cardinality/search/autocomplete/count/preview/inspection/export/diagnostic/notification/receipt or optional-AI context; hidden cardinality is not exposed.
resolved_contract.persistence_decision: No durable KFR-07 persistence, duplicate index, provenance ledger or canonical write store; migration 0022 remains unreserved.
resolved_contract.accessibility: Accessible nonvisual search, inspection, provenance, authorization and authoring-boundary equivalents implemented.

preserved_boundaries: KFR-01 through KFR-06 remain completed_verified with implementation authority retired.
Canonical KFR owners, source-domain owners, AuthoringAuthority/AuthoringDraft/AuthoringProposalReview and Permission/visibility systems remain authoritative.
No canonical write, publish, reveal, canonical promotion, permission escalation, provenance fabrication, hidden-data reveal, durable persistence or migration 0022 was introduced.
KFR-08 is successor selection only; ODL-01+, provider activation, tester distribution, release and deployment remain unauthorized.
